title: Senior Accountant
description: Own month-end close, account reconciliations and journal entries under GAAP. Prepare financial statements and support audits. 4+ years of accounting experience; CPA preferred. Strong Excel; QuickBooks or an ERP such as SAP or Oracle.

title: HR Generalist
description: Run recruiting, onboarding, benefits administration and employee relations for a 300-person company. Maintain HRIS records and ensure compliance with labor law (FMLA, ADA, EEO). 3+ years in HR; PHR or SHRM-CP a plus.

title: IT Systems Administrator
description: Administer Windows Server, Active Directory and Microsoft 365. Manage networking (TCP/IP, VPN, firewalls), backups and endpoint security. Provide tier-2 help desk support. 3+ years in IT operations; CompTIA or Microsoft certifications preferred.

title: B2B Account Executive
description: Own a quota for new-business sales to mid-market companies. Prospect, run demos, negotiate and close. Manage pipeline in Salesforce. 3+ years of B2B sales with a record of meeting or exceeding quota.

title: Elementary School Teacher
description: Teach a grade 3-5 classroom: plan standards-aligned lessons, differentiate instruction, assess progress and communicate with parents. State teaching certification required; classroom management experience expected.

title: Executive Chef
description: Lead kitchen operations for a high-volume restaurant: menu development, food costing, ordering and inventory, and food safety (ServSafe). Hire, train and schedule kitchen staff. 5+ years in professional kitchens with supervisory experience.

title: Graphic Designer
description: Create brand, marketing and digital assets: social graphics, print collateral, presentations and web visuals. Expert in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign); Figma a plus. Portfolio required; 2+ years of design experience.

title: Healthcare Operations Coordinator
description: Coordinate clinic operations: patient scheduling, insurance verification, medical records (EHR) and HIPAA compliance. Work with physicians and nursing staff to improve patient flow. 3+ years in a healthcare setting; medical terminology required.
